scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit
scripts.test: tsx --test src/security.test.ts src/main/input-validation.test.ts src/main/desktop-lifecycle.test.ts src/renderer/diagnostics.test.ts src/renderer/realtime.test.ts src/renderer/task-feed.test.ts src/renderer/approval-feed.test.ts src/renderer/mobile-pairing.test.ts
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs
